svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 10/12 Santa Ana Afternoon (Common)
svg.desc: Some autumn days the wind blows in from the desert. Hot, dry, and the hills look close enough to touch. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
